answer: Cap what a new identity can earn and raise the cap only with clean history. A fresh agent may earn at most 1,000 POA per epoch, and the cap doubles only after each epoch of honest, attested work, so ten clean epochs pass before full earnings. A sybil farmer's thousand fakes each sit at the bottom rung, so the whole swarm earns less than one honest agent while the farmer still pays to run every fake. New identities arrive like a zephyr, fast and weightless, but each one must present its cipher, a signed record of past work, at every vertex it touches before its cap ever rises.
